name: rp_static_spread_carry_TLT_IEF_a
rationale: The NY Fed ACM 10-year term premium has returned to clearly positive territory in 2026 (0.79% as of 2026-07-30) after roughly five years near or below zero, and the long end has bear-steepened on Treasury supply and QT rather than on the expected short-rate path -- the 30-year cleared 5.25% in late July 2026 (highest since 2007) against a ~4.70% 10-year, a ~55bp 10s30s slope. A static always-on long-TLT/short-IEF spread is the plainest way to harvest that duration risk premium inside UNIVERSE: it holds the 20y+ sector against the 7-10y sector, gets paid the term-premium differential with no directional forecast, and bears the real risk that the same supply pressure pushes the premium higher still. Distinct from family N's DEAD pairs_cointegration row, which tested TLT/IEF as a mean-reverting spread (and dropped it at the ADF filter, never traded OOS); this is a structural carry bet on the spread's level, not on its reversion.
citation: Adrian, Crump & Moench (2013), 'Pricing the Term Structure with Linear Regressions', NY Fed ACM term premia (newyorkfed.org/research/data_indicators/term-premia-tabs) -- 10y ACM term premium 0.79% at 2026-07-30; 30y Treasury 5.25% vs 10y ~4.70% late July 2026 (mariemontcapital.com/fomc-minutes-july-2026/, primerates.com Treasury yield curve, ferrantecapitaladvisers.com/insights/treasury-term-premium-regime-2026/).
